---
name: SVG demo (computed by your browser's filter engine)
about: Type some text; your browser's SVG filters compute a tiny neural net on it
title: "svg: "
---

Put some text in the **title** after `svg:` (letters, spaces and basic punctuation), then Submit. An Action writes your text into an SVG and replies with the picture. Your browser's SVG filter engine does all the arithmetic; the Action does none. Works at 1x pixel ratio in Chrome. Leave this body as is.
